name: The Flight Log [GAMER]
notes: Repaired Flight Log for recorder 0.6.14 or newer. Preserves the TV/file visual repairs, White Door hover confirmation at task 8, and final radial-button wait. Task 10 goes directly to its saved chat input (something wrong?) and Enter; two incidental scene-click sequences were removed. 218 steps. Three-minute timer starts at action 11 and holds before action 210. Full uninterrupted replay remains unverified.

checkpoint.text:
A routine night shift at the control tower. Just a desk, a radar, and the quiet of the skies. But as the night deepens… silence begins to tell a different story.
NOTE: Turn the sound on for a chilling experience.
